3.t: The following information includes the necessary retrofit instructions for changing the Gravitar upright game into a Black Widow game. The modifications include changing the cabinet graphics, the control panel, the hamess assembly, certain game board components, and the self-test label. Information is also provided for changing the Gravitar Schematic Package Supplement (SP-206) to reflect the Black Widow circuitry.
